name: cicd-pipeline-design
description: Design CI/CD pipeline: source → build → test → security-scan → artifact → deploy → verify → rollback. Tool selection (GitHub Actions / GitLab / Jenkins / CircleCI / Buildkite / Azure Pipelines / Tekton / Argo). Pipeline stages, quality gates (tests / SAST / SCA / license / container scan), artifact management, deployment strategy (blue-green / canary / rolling / progressive), observability integration, secrets via OIDC federation. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
